summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, announcing the agenda for its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM). The AGM, scheduled for June 10, 2026, will cover routine proposals including approval of the 2025 Annual Accounts, a final dividend of EUR 0.21 per common share, and board composition changes. The filing also notes director nominations and terms, including extension of CEO Lard Friese's term and appointment of Leni Boeren. This is a routine AGM notice with no special situation transaction or forced management change; category is None.
